author.title: Mafalda Timóteo
author.description: Junior Data Analyst with a Biomedical Engineering background. I transform complex data into clear insights that support better decisions in healthcare and business. With experience in Python, SQL, statistical analysis and data visualisation, I enjoy exploring data, identifying meaningful patterns and communicating findings in a clear and practical way.
